roles_alternate: this model's template requires the roles to alternate (user, assistant, user…), with a single system instruction, at the start.
down: The built-in engine is not responding ({error}).
context_exceeded: The text is {needed} tokens long; this model accepts {limit}.
refused: The built-in engine does not accept this request: {error}
failed: The built-in engine could not answer: {error}
model_missing: The model “{model}” is not on this machine.
embedding_only: “{model}” is an embedding model: it cannot chat.
no_vision: “{model}” cannot see images on this machine: pick a model that can (qwen3.5…).
no_infill: “{model}” cannot complete code in the middle of a text (it lacks the completion tokens): pick a code model (qwen2.5-coder…).
text_too_long: Text too long for “{model}”: {tokens} tokens, {limit} at most per text with the built-in engine. Split it.
